content.value: a. A round bar of length L tapers uniformly from radius ${ \bf r } _ { 1 }$ at one end to radius $\boldsymbol { \mathrm { r } } _ { 2 }$ at (15) the other. Show that extension produced by a tensile axial load P is $\mathrm { P L } / 2 \pi \mathrm { E r } _ { 1 } ^ { 2 }$

b. A reinforced concrete foundation beam ABCD that supports a uniform load (20) intensity q lb/ft. Determine the maximum load intensity q if the shear force at point B and bending moment at E are 1800 lb and 2500 lb-ft respectively. Assume factor of safety for shear and bending moment are 2.5 and 3, respectively.
